List the project's latest events, newest first, optionally of one event name or one person.

A person is named by a distinct id, a person id or an email. The API filters events by name only, so
a search for one person reads the latest 1,000 events and says when that was not all of them.

Usage:
  voidhash events list [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show help for this command
      --json               Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --limit <limit>      How many events to show (default: 25)
      --name <name>        Only events with this name, such as $pageview or purchase_completed
      --person <person>    Only events of this person: a distinct id, person id or email
      --project <project>  Project to act on: its id, slug, organization/slug or name (default: this
                           directory's project, then your default project)
  -q, --quiet              Print only ids, one per line

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash events list
  voidhash events list --name purchase_completed --limit 50
  voidhash events list --person dana@example.com --json
